about_title: A fiber laser for every shop, from the first 4 × 4 ft machine to 60 kW plate gantries
about_text: A fiber laser cutting machine cuts sheet and plate from a DXF file with a focused beam — mild steel to 2″ and beyond with the high-power sources — at speeds no plasma or punch can match, with a clean edge and no tooling. Senfeng's range starts with single-table enclosed machines that ship in one container and plug in the day they arrive, and the NP open-type laser that is the lowest-priced 12 kW machine in the catalogue; the H series adds a full enclosure and a 20-second pallet changer for production, in 1.5 to 80 kW; the HM cuts sheet and tube on one machine; the R and TX gantries take plate to 10 × 164 ft with ±45° bevels; the TD five-axis machine and RC robot cells trim formed parts; and the coil-fed lines cut straight from the coil with no sheet handling.

Senfeng Laser has built fiber laser machines in Jinan, Shandong, since 2004: a 1.8 million ft² campus, its own laser sources, cutting heads and welding guns, around 15,000 machines a year, 20 overseas branches and Senfeng Laser USA with a warehouse and service team. CE, FDA and ETL certified. NovoTech sells, installs and supports the machines in Canada from Mississauga, Ontario, Canada — layout for your building, installation, operator training, a CSA-approved panel, a 1-year warranty and parts and technical support in Canada.
